A series of short videos (each under 5 minutes) for R and the tidyverse. Each tip
pairs a video with a companion page that runs the same code, so you can watch,
then do.

The tips are ordered to flow: environment $\to$ data $\to$ tidyverse $\to$ ggplot $\to$ infer $\to$
tidymodels $\to$ Quarto reports. Where a tip draws on a MATH 1051 lab, the page links
to it.

::: {.callout-note}
Tips are being filmed. Pages marked *coming soon* will get their video and
runnable code as the series progresses.
:::

## 1. Getting started

- [Install & load packages](tips/01-getting-started/01-install-load.html) --- install.packages() vs library(), CRAN, the `pkg::fn()` form
- [Variables & assignment](tips/01-getting-started/02-variables.html) --- `<-`, what a variable holds, naming
- [The pipe `|>`](tips/01-getting-started/03-pipe.html) --- chaining operations
- [Quarto + RStudio setup](tips/01-getting-started/04-quarto-rstudio.html) --- chunks, inline R, knitting
- [Reading data](tips/01-getting-started/05-reading-data.html) --- read_csv() / read_excel(), tibble vs data.frame
- [Looking at a tibble](tips/01-getting-started/06-looking-at-tibble.html) --- names(), str(), head(), dim()
